item.tib: thugs rje chen po 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud tshe yi sgrub pa ye shes go cha las lung bstan ye shes rnam gsal le'u nyi shu pa
item.coloph: o rgyan byang chub snying po bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal gyis/ kre shod pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gnas kyi nub phyogs dbang gi gnas sgor/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i 'dra 'bag chen po'i gnas kyi mdun phyogs/ gnam gzhung pha wong pad+ma can nas/ chu byi hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyi dros kyi dus la spyan drangs pas/ slar chu glang hor zla dang po'i tshes la/ hor kre bo'i dpon sku mched lha byin rab brtan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor bzhin/ zab chos lung dang mthun pa'i chos bdag rten 'brel yod bzhin pho brang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling nas/ shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur grub pa'o/ de yang shog ser gyi rgyu ni ye shes kyi shing bi ma zhes pa yin 'dug cing / ring thung kho bo byang chub pa rang gi saur mo nyi shu yod pa zhing sor mo drug snang zhing / yi ge ni mkha' 'gro'i brda 'gyur gcig pa'i yig rigs su snang ba'i yig 'phreng nyi shu phyed rtsa brgyad 'dug pa'i ngo la zhal bshus grub pa'o//
